findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b · Private data: x402_bazaar_token_verdict_v2__base_token_verdict_v3, x402_eth_reads_v1__base_tx_explain, x402_eth_reads_v1__base_wallet_snapshot, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_allowance, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_balanceof, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_totalsupply, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_ownerof, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_tokens_of, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_token_reads_bundle, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_wallet_bundle, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict_preview, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_token_verdict_v3 · Public sink: x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_ens_resolve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b · Private data: x402_bazaar_token_verdict_v2__base_token_verdict_v3, x402_eth_reads_v1__base_tx_explain, x402_eth_reads_v1__base_wallet_snapshot, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_allowance, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_balanceof, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_totalsupply, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_ownerof, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc721_tokens_of, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_token_reads_bundle, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_wallet_bundle, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_mainnet_token_verdict_preview, x402_eth_token_verdict_v1__eth_token_verdict_v3 · Public sink: x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_deepseek_v3_2, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_llama3_1_8b, x402_eth_reads_v1__chat_qwen3_32b, x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_ens_resolve
